import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.LaurentReducedReduction
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LaurentTwoChartCoboundary

open Polynomial LaurentPolynomial
namespace ProbePicC6
open AlgebraicGeometry
variable {A : Type} [CommRing A]

noncomputable abbrev redL (A : Type) [CommRing A] :
    LaurentPolynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial (A ⧸ nilradical A) :=
  AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom ℤ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical A))

-- Does the chart square commute?  redL ∘ toLaurent = toLaurent ∘ mapRingHom
example (p : Polynomial A) :
    redL A (Polynomial.toLaurent p)
      = Polynomial.toLaurent (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical A)) p) := by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | monomial n a =>
      simp [Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_X_pow, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom]
      sorry

end ProbePicC6
